notes.title: Release Notes And Controller Support
notes.content:
First of all, if you've bought this game, a big thank you for supporting starting indy devs such as myself. It is extremely appreciated.

I just wanted to make a quick announcement to mention that I still plan to support this game to the best of my abilities and my time. If anyone has any bugs or any thing that does not work well, please let me know. You can post on the steam forums, I will definitely keep an eye on it as often as possible.

On the topic of Controller Support: I had planned for it to be available for the release, but unfortunately I did not have access to my own controller for the past two months. I should be able to rectify this in an update for January. Sorry for the delay for those that really like to play these games with a gamepad. I'll make due.

Until next time,
[i]- Vincent Frappier[/i]
